title: Avocado Choka | Zaboca Choka
ldName: 📖 Avocado Choka / Zaboca Choka Recipe Card
ldKeywords: aloo choka, Avocado Choka, trini choka, trinidad choka, What is Choka?, Zaboca Choka
ldInstructionsRaw: Slice the avocado into quarters around the seed. Remove the seed and peel off the skin.
Place the avocado in a bowl.
Add onion, garlic, hot pepper, and salt.
Mash until smooth and creamy, with no chunks remaining.
Serve immediately with sada roti, toast, or fried bake.
htmlIngredientLines: 1 avocado large, or 2 smaller Hass avocados
Hot pepper finely chopped, to taste
